summary: Critical: aggregate-results.sh (line 2) and run-act-harness.sh (line 1) use `set -uo pipefail` instead of `set -euo pipefail`—missing `-e` violates bash safety best practices. Fragile: lib/junit_parser.sh regex parsing (lines 24-26, _junit_attr) lacks robustness; boundary detection brittle. Global state in lib/aggregator.sh (associative arrays) impairs testability. TSV pipeline undervalidated. Library files sourced but lack set -euo pipefail headers. Positives: good error messages, jq for safe JSON parsing, trap/cleanup patterns, workflow triggers/permissions sound. Would not ship without `-e` fix.
